Accounting Services

Bookkeeping & Accounting Support That Keeps Your Numbers Audit-Ready

From daily bookkeeping to monthly MIS reports, we keep your books accurate and current — so tax filing, funding conversations, and audits are never a scramble.

📅 Book Consultation 💬 WhatsApp Us

Overview

Accounting That Doesn't Fall Behind

Most compliance problems — missed GST input credit, wrong tax estimates, cash flow surprises — start with books that aren't updated regularly. We run your day-to-day accounting on a fixed schedule, so your financial position is always current and your other filings are built on clean data.

Whether you need a full outsourced accounting function or support alongside your in-house team, we adapt to how your business already works.

Book Consultation

What We Offer

Every Layer of Your Accounting Function

📒

Bookkeeping

Day-to-day recording of sales, purchases, expenses and receipts, kept current on a fixed monthly or weekly schedule.

🧑‍💼

Accounting Outsourcing

A full outsourced accounting function — from data entry to finalisation — so you don't need to build an in-house team.

💻

Virtual Accounting

Cloud-based accounting with remote access, so you can review your numbers anytime without waiting for a monthly report.

📄

Financial Statements

Accurate Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow statements prepared in line with applicable accounting standards.

📊

MIS Reporting

Management information reports — expense trends, receivables ageing, department-wise costs — built around how you make decisions.

🏦

Bank Reconciliation

Regular matching of your books against bank statements to catch errors, duplicate entries or missed transactions early.

Who Needs This

Built for Businesses That Can't Afford Messy Books

  • Startups that need investor-ready financials without a full finance team
  • SMEs currently maintaining books in spreadsheets or informally
  • Businesses switching accountants and needing a clean handover
  • Companies preparing for their first statutory audit
  • Growing businesses that have outgrown ad-hoc bookkeeping

Benefits

What Accurate Books Actually Get You

  • Tax filings built on clean, reconciled data — fewer notices
  • Real-time visibility into cash position and receivables
  • Audit-ready records with no year-end scramble
  • Reports that support decisions, not just compliance

Our Process

How We Take Over Your Books

1. Onboarding & Data Migration

We review your current books (or set up fresh), migrate opening balances, and agree a reporting calendar.

2. Regular Bookkeeping

Transactions are recorded and reconciled on a fixed weekly or monthly schedule — never batched at year-end.

3. Review & Reporting

You receive periodic financial statements and MIS reports, with a call to walk through anything material.

4. Year-End Finalisation

Books are finalised and handed to our tax and audit teams for filing — no re-work, no delays.

Why Choose A B KHAN & ASSOCIATES

One Team for Books, Tax and Compliance

🔄

Fixed Schedule

Books are updated on a set cadence, not left until a deadline forces it.

🔗

Connected to Tax & Audit

The same firm handles your books, filings and audit — nothing gets lost in handoffs.

📱

Cloud Access

Review your financials anytime through cloud accounting tools, not just at month-end.

🛡️

Data Security

Confidential financial data handled with strict access controls throughout.
